# VRCoreRule

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Validation` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Editor/Validation/Rules/SceneRules.cs#L42)

VRCore drives the whole init sequence off one serialized array. A module that is in the
scene but not in that array never initialises and never registers its service, which is by
far the most common way a framework scene silently does nothing.
